lines.text: Right, six weeks since the repair on your right shoulder, how's it been out of the sling?
Out of the sling since Monday, like the surgeon said.
Well, welcome to week six, this is where the real work starts.
I'm still getting tingling in my little and ring fingers at night, though I'm half asleep so I can't really be sure.
Let me have a look. Lifting your arm out in front, I can take it to 90 degrees, beyond that it's guarded.
The tingling's probably from the nerve at the elbow getting squashed while you sleep, I'd suspect.
Keep your elbow straighter in bed, a towel wrapped round it overnight helps.
Now, lean on the table and let the arm swing in small circles, a minute each way, three times a day.
The surgeon's letter says tramadol, is that still okay?
Yes, tramadol 50 milligrams up to four times a day is fine, but don't drive if it makes you drowsy.
No lifting anything heavier than a cup of tea with that arm.
Same time next week, yes. Take care.
